def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(version_str):
        # Split by '+' to separate build metadata
        version_part, _, build = version_str.partition('+')
        
        # Split by '-' to separate pre-release
        parts = version_part.split('-', 1)
        core = parts[0]
        prerelease = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        major, minor, patch = map(int, core.split('.'))
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            for identifier in prerelease.split('.'):
                if identifier.isdigit():
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((0, int(identifier)))  # (0, num) for numeric
                else:
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((1, identifier))  # (1, str) for non-numeric
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers, version_str)
    
    def compare_key(version_str, index):
        major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers, original = parse_version(version_str)
        
        # For sorting:
        # 1. Compare MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH numerically
        # 2. Version without pre-release sorts after version with pre-release
        #    (so we use len(prerelease_identifiers) > 0 to make pre-release come first)
        # 3. Pre-release identifiers compared left to right
        # 4. Maintain input order for equal versions (index)
        
        return (major, minor, patch, (len(prerelease_identifiers) == 0,), prerelease_identifiers, index)
    
    indexed_versions = [(v, i) for i, v in enumerate(versions)]
    indexed_versions.sort(key=lambda x: compare_key(x[0], x[1]))
    
    return [v for v, _ in indexed_versions]
